summary: Iteration 51: Final Consolidation & Integrity retest (backend and frontend, web preview at 375x667). Suites: node tests 54/54 pass, tsc --noEmit clean, ESLint clean, backend pytest 129/129 pass. History world: /world/history has 3 campaign chips (history-1 'Josua & Richter' with 14 stations, history 'Israels Geschichte: Land, Bund und Königtum' with 16 stations, history-tribes with 3 stations). The 16 restored stations are listed in the expected order with correct lock states. /station/hist-kings-solomon and /station/hist-chronicles-david were each completed end to end (mc/tf/free/match tasks plus 2 exam questions, 'Prüfung: 2 von 2 richtig', +60 EP, next station unlocked). Matching: the right-hand column was rendered shuffled ([1,0,2] and [0,3,1,2]) and correct pairs graded 'Richtig!'. Search: 'Im Anfang war das Wort' returns Joh 1,1 first, and 'Gott ist Liebe' returns 1Joh 4,8 first. Settings: font scale persists after reload (19.55px for Groß), and the theme selection persists, but on web the UI stays light (known react-native-web limitation, see iteration 45). JSON export and import work (an imported station shows 1/16). An import with invalid settings (theme 'neon', fontScale 'huge') is sanitized to System/Normal without a crash. Full backup on web: the download is created with toast 'Vollsicherung erstellt (0 Fotos).'. Rejection cases all give a specific error toast with 0 localStorage keys changed: invalid JSON, wrong kind, way.entries containing an invalid entry, and an invalid base64 photo. A valid restore shows the toast 'Wiederhergestellt: Lernstand, 1 Tagebucheintrag, 0 Fotos…'; after reload the diary entry, note and station progress are all present. ONE BUG FOUND: a full backup whose diary entry has only {id, date} passes validation, and the in-memory way store then holds an un-normalized entry. Opening the diary without a reload crashes the app ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading icon)'). After a reload the entry is normalized and shows correctly. Regression checks pass: Röm 8,28 commentary panel (Streitenberger, Calvin and Rieger cards; filters toggle; compare/Liste toggle; 'Römer 8,28-39'), and /library, /lexicon, /timeline, /way and /intro all render without errors. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-audio and expo-video are used).

ui_bugs.issue: Restoring a Vollsicherung whose way.entries contains a minimal entry ({id, date} without kind/feelings/refs…) passes validWay(). way.restore(b.way,'replace') then stores the raw entry in memory, and opening /way → Persönliches Register without a reload crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading icon)'. After a reload, normalize() fixes the entry, so data is not lost, but the app crashes until it is restarted. Reference: frontend/src/lib/fullBackup.ts:77-79,186 and frontend/src/lib/way.ts:182-183

issues: theme-dark is saved, but the web preview stays light: react-native-web has no Appearance.setColorScheme (known since iteration 45). Should work on native, but not verifiable here.

action_items: Fix the in-memory un-normalized diary data after a full restore. Option 1: export normalize() from way.ts and call way.restore(normalize(b.way),'replace') in fullBackup.ts. Option 2 (simplest): make way.restore() normalize its input itself (d = normalize(d)), which also protects other callers.
Optional: decide whether a structurally incomplete diary entry (missing kind or arrays) should be rejected instead of normalized; the current validWay checks only id and date.

Update docs/final-consolidation-integrity.md: 'Remaining release gates' 1 and 2 still say the yarn.lock is absent and that the full backup excludes MP3/MP4 with no rollback. Both are now done (frontend/yarn.lock is git-tracked, and staging/rollback/media are implemented). It also still says '45 frontend tests' (now 54).
critical_code_review_comments: fullBackup.ts:107-108: invalid media items are silently dropped, while their files in media.files are still staged and moved into documents/media. This leaves orphaned files that no list references (storage leak on native).

fullBackup.ts:181: photos in the state whose files are not in the backup keep the source device's file:// URI, which gives broken thumbnails on the new device. Consider flagging or dropping them in the success toast.
settings.tsx:60-76: doRestore does not set busy, so a double tap on restore-confirm or full-restore during a running restore can start a second restore at the same time.
fullBackup.ts: the AsyncStorage keys and Way data are written before p.replaceState(). A failure there is correctly rolled back (r.rollback), and replace() in store.tsx throws properly. OK.
Native-only paths (photo/media staging, disk-space check, file move with undo directory) were reviewed by code only, not executed. They need a real-device roundtrip, as the doc itself states.
TaskView shuffleDifferent guarantees a non-identity order for match and order tasks; grading uses original indices. OK.

rca_of_issue: Repro: build a full backup with way.entries=[{id:'x',date:'2026-01-16'}], then Settings → Vollsicherung wiederherstellen → choose the file (success toast) → navigate client-side to /way → Persönliches Register → error boundary 'reading icon'. Cause: fullBackup.validWay() checks only id and date; way.restore(...,'replace') calls set(d) without normalize(), so DiaryHome reads KIND_BY_ID[undefined].icon and e.feelings.length. normalize() runs only when loading from storage, which is why a reload fixes it. Way's own restore (app/way/data.tsx) uses parseWayBackup(), which normalizes, so it is not affected. Mitigation: normalize inside way.restore() or before calling it in fullBackup.ts.
